physics-killer-04.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-04.material: Gaaraa ol-ka'iinsa $20\,\mathrm{m}$ qabu fiixee irraa kubbaan sararaan darbatame, gaaraa jala lafa irratti gaaraa irraa fageenya sararaa $30\,\mathrm{m}$ irratti kufte. $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ fi diddaan qilleensaa yoo dagatame, yeroo lafa tuqu saffisa kubbaa fi yeroo sana kontaanaa kallattiin saffisaa sararaa wajjin uumu $\theta$ ni $\tan\theta$ hordoffiidhaan sirriitti kan wal-qabsiise isa kami?
physics-killer-04.s.s1.prompt: Gaaraa ol-ka'iinsa $20\,\mathrm{m}$ qabu fiixee irraa kubbaan sararaan darbatame, gaaraa jala lafa irratti gaaraa irraa fageenya sararaa $30\,\mathrm{m}$ irratti kufte. $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ fi diddaan qilleensaa yoo dagatame, yeroo lafa tuqu saffisa kubbaa fi yeroo sana kontaanaa kallattiin saffisaa sararaa wajjin uumu $\theta$ ni $\tan\theta$ hordoffiidhaan sirriitti kan wal-qabsiise isa kami?
physics-killer-04.s.s1.explain: Kallattii qajeelaa $20=\frac12\cdot10\cdot t^2\Rightarrow t=2\,\mathrm{s}$. Kallattii sararaa $30=v_0t\Rightarrow v_0=15\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Lafa tuquu dura $v_y=gt=20\,\mathrm{m/s}$. $v=\sqrt{15^2+20^2}=25\,\mathrm{m/s}$, $\tan\theta=\dfrac{v_y}{v_0}=\dfrac{20}{15}=\dfrac43$. Saffisa $v_0+gt=35$ yoo ida'an deebii dogoggoraa ①, $\tan\theta$ yoo garagalchan $\frac34$ (deebii dogoggoraa ②), kutaa qajeelaa $20\,\mathrm{m/s}$ qofa saffisa yoo godhan deebii dogoggoraa ④ ta'a.
physics-killer-04.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-04.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
